items.criterion: A placed order raises one USD invoice for its total on the Kill Bill account keyed tock- plus the buyer email in lowercase.
items.judgment: Place an order for a mixed-case signup and read the invoices on the account with that external key.

items.criterion: A placed order sends the buyer one confirmation mail whose subject begins Tock order confirmed: with the order number.
items.judgment: Place an order and read the mailbox for that address.

items.criterion: An order for TOCK 33 Aqua alone carries subtotal 18900, shipping 1500 and total 20400 in usd.
items.judgment: Check out one TOCK 33 Aqua and read the order fields and the stored row.

items.criterion: Simultaneous adds of the last available unit admit one cart each round.
items.judgment: Release eight adds of a one-unit sku together over fifteen rounds and count the winners and the reserved column.

items.criterion: The stock ledger deltas for each inventory item sum to its on hand units.
items.judgment: Sum the ledger deltas per inventory item and compare against on_hand.

items.criterion: Replaying a checkout with its Idempotency-Key returns the same order number with one invoice.
items.judgment: Send one checkout twice with the same key and compare numbers, order rows and invoices.

items.criterion: Selecting each tock sets the bezel rotation to the start minute minus the tock start, times six, modulo 360.
items.judgment: Select all four tocks on the home page and read the three dial hooks after each.

items.criterion: The Tock dial caption reads It's in the H. H:MM. for each slider time.
items.judgment: Move the slider to five pinned times and read the right caption.

items.criterion: A bundle reads the availability of its scarcer watch and unavailable when either watch has none.
items.judgment: Set both Glow watches to four stock pairs and read the bundle availability after each.

items.criterion: A cart holding a watch carries one gift Tock Tote line and one gift Tock Beanie line.
items.judgment: Add a watch to a new cart and count the gift lines per sku.

items.criterion: Another customer's order number answers 404 as a missing number does.
items.judgment: Request TK-SEEDED01 and a missing number as customer@example.com and compare the statuses.

items.criterion: A restock from zero mails each waiting subscriber one Back in stock message.
items.judgment: Subscribe two addresses, restock twice and count the restock mails per address.

items.criterion: A pending review leaves the listed reviews and the review count unchanged.
items.judgment: Submit a review and read the product review count and list before and after.

items.criterion: An anonymous visit to the checkout page redirects to the sign-in page with return_to set to the checkout path.
items.judgment: Request the checkout page without a session and read the redirect location.

items.criterion: Home, a collection, a product page and the cart keep their width inside a 390 pixel viewport.
items.judgment: Open the four pages at 390 pixels and compare the document width with the window width.

items.criterion: The first keyboard stop on the home page is the Skip to content link.
items.judgment: Press Tab once on the home page and read the focused control.
